prompt: Set up CI for this repository of standards and validation scripts.
setup: Validate and unit-test commands use the same lockfile, runtime and runner and finish in two minutes. The repository distributes source and has no publish command.
expected: ci.yml defines a CI workflow with one ci runner job. Checkout, setup, install, validate and test each have a consistent single-quoted step name. Workflow, job and step keys follow the documented order. Simple inputs fit inline within 160 columns, with one blank line between steps and none between their properties.
must_not: Add stored secrets, a local setup action, shell wrapper, reusable workflow, artifact, matrix or release path for these existing commands.
